conditions: Needs the Dagath's Hollow room built in a Clan Dojo; visit a clan that has it if yours doesn't.

groups.activity: reach Rank 2, then buy Abyssal Beacons
conditions: Any of the six main Syndicates (Steel Meridian, Arbiters of Hexis, Cephalon Suda, Perrin Sequence, Red Veil, New Loka) sells the beacon at Rank 2 for 5,000 standing.
Only the mission host's beacon is consumed, and the daily standing cap is tracked per syndicate.
bonuses: Squad up in recruiting chat and rotate host so only one beacon burns per run.

disclosures.title: the standing math
disclosures.body: 13 Steel Path runs (65,000 standing) or 17 normal runs (85,000) covers Vainthorn for the frame alone; her signature Dorrclave needs about as much again.

groups.mode: Steel Path recommended; no public matchmaking

rows.label: Vainthorn
rows.note: 34 per component; needs an Abyssal Beacon to enter

conditions: No public matchmaking on either difficulty — recruit a premade in recruiting chat.
Find one Orokin Defixio per squad member and carry it to extraction; carrying one limits you to secondary and melee and applies a random curse.
If the host leaves, the mission fails for everyone.
bonuses: Steel Path raises the roll to 8, 11 or 12 Vainthorn plus a Steel Essence, cutting both beacons and runs needed.
The Eximus Stronghold phase near the end is also a good Riven Sliver farm.

disclosures.title: dodge the curse
disclosures.body: Pick up the Defixio as the Warframe, switch to Operator to walk it to extraction, then switch back — it deposits instantly with no curse. If a curse is nasty, drop it and grab a different Defixio instead.

disclosures.title: Steel Path Acolytes can eat the objective
disclosures.body: An Acolyte spawning near an unclaimed Defixio can make it vanish, softlocking the mission (flagged by the wiki as a possible bug). Grab a Defixio before an Acolyte shows if you can.
